name: KolektorSDD: Kolektor Surface-Defect Dataset
description: Surface-defect detection and segmentation benchmark consisting of 399 microscopic images of electrical commutators captured in an active manufacturing line by Kolektor Group. Features 52 images containing fractured surfaces, microscopic cracks, and scratches with pixel-accurate ground truth segmentation masks, and 347 defect-free images.
